mapper.sql:
where del_flag = 0
and (role_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or role_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.select:
select id, role_code, role_name, data_scope, sort, status, remark, create_time from sys_role
order by sort, id limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select * from sys_role where del_flag = 0 and status = 1 order by sort, id
select * from sys_role where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0
select r.* from sys_employee_role er join sys_role r on r.id = er.role_id and r.del_flag = 0 where er.employee_id = #{employeeId} order by r.id
mapper.insert: insert into sys_role (role_code, role_name, data_scope, sort, status, remark, create_by, update_by) values (#{roleCode}, #{roleName}, #{dataScope}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.update: update sys_role set del_flag = 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
